Taverna

At the taverna

From the menu and what guests write on Google.

From the grill

Souvlaki, sieftalia, chicken, lamb chops and pork chops. Every portion comes with salad, chips and pitta bread.

Meze

Pork and chicken souvlaki, lountza, pork bacon, sausage, halloumi, mushrooms, sieftalia and potatoes, with salad, pitta and sides.

Beer garden

Tables outside among the olive trees, as the sign says: Kebab House & Beer Garden.

In Pegeia

On Sea Caves Avenue in Pegeia, near Paphos. Open Tuesday to Saturday from 15:00 to 22:00 and Sunday from 12:00 to 22:30, closed on Monday. Call 99 510814.
